courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「鋼管截面與軸應力」與「沖刷與側向剛度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型港口沉箱碼頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Steel-pipe section and axial stress" and "Scour and lateral stiffness" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Large-port caisson quay walls must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載；大型港口沉箱碼頭則以將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability; Large-port caisson quay walls centres on trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼管截面與軸應力」與「主動土壓假設」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型港口沉箱碼頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「護舷曲線積分」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” and “Active earth-pressure assumptions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Large-port caisson quay walls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Integrating fender response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” and “Pontoon loading and draft”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mooring systems for floating docks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Parallel restoring stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基
history.text: 棧橋碼頭把平台荷載經樁傳入海床，與重力沉箱的連續底面接觸有不同分析需求。一九九一年工兵團樁基手冊涵蓋調查、試樁與設計；香港碼頭與繫船墩分冊另提供海事使用背景，實際應用仍須核對現行修訂。洛杉磯港官方紀錄一七七至一八二號碼頭重建在二〇二三年開始、二〇二五年完成，工程議程包含混凝土樁與新碼頭。本課鋼管幾何只是另一材料情境，不把它說成該專案規格。北角碼頭則比較公共通達功能。十個算例以原創數據串起截面、土阻、變形、沖刷及耐久。
history.textEn: A pile-supported pier transfers deck loads into the seabed through discrete members, unlike continuous base contact beneath a gravity caisson. The1991 USACE manual addresses exploration, testing and pile design, while Hong Kong pier-and-dolphin guidance adds maritime context subject to current revisions. Los Angeles records Berths177–182 restoration beginning in2023 and completing in2025, with official agenda material identifying concrete piles and a new wharf. Steel-pipe geometry here is a separate material scenario, not that project’s specification. Pak Kok provides a public-access comparison. Ten original numerical exercises connect sections, soil resistance, deformation, scour and durability.

history.textEn: The course turns "Steel-pipe section and axial stress" through "Cyclic demand and fatigue" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
